body:
Apparently, enums are considered to have a value according to the `ts.Symbol.flag`, which includes `ts.SymbolFlags.Value`:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/66e6b932d818a161bd19c03e3e854a22552a7db2/packages/compiler-cli/src/transformers/downlevel_decorators_transform.ts#L307-L310

Besides this logic, the following also needs to be verified:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/18098d38b8c49c4f1897cd1edf757de4adcbdef2/packages/compiler-cli/src/ngtsc/reflection/src/type_to_value.ts#L39-L41

issue.body:
We had a couple of places where we were assuming that if a particular symbol has a value, then it will exist at runtime. This is true in most cases, but it breaks down for `const` enums.

Fixes #38513.
